messages:
mira: opening a tiny PR to add a 'scale safeguards' section for Dedicated capacity onboarding. asking for a quick sanity-check on eviction wording and isolation tag examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
dev-bot: PR created by mira: docs/pull/512 1 reviewers: @ash @ops-kim
dash: +1 for a short definition of 'isolation tags' at the start. users hit that mistake often.
ops-kim: ops note: call out 'eviction semantics' with two terms we use internally: 'best-effort eviction' (tries to drain, may restart) and 'forced eviction' (immediate reclaim). prefer we avoid 'preemption' alone.
mira: adding that language. planning a tiny 2-row clarification box comparing the two terms and an example timeline for each.
lex: could you include a short Go SDK snippet? infra folks often write provisioning code in Go.
mira: good idea. adding both a one-liner Go snippet and a small YAML.
nash: sample YAML (short):
```
# provisioning/guardrails/sample-capacity.yaml
capacity:
  id: billing-team-pool
  reserved_gpus: 6
  isolation_tags: ["billing", "us-west-2"]
  scale_policy:
    target_utilization: 0.6
    cooldown_seconds: 180
    min_replicas: 1
```
lex: Go SDK example (illustrative):
```
import "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/dedicated"
client := dedicated.NewClient()
client.CreateCapacity(ctx, dedicated.Capacity{ Name: "billing-team-pool", GPUs: 6, IsolationTags: []string{"billing","us-west-2"} })
```
ops-kim: ops nit: add a small bullet about health-check windows and hysteresis: use cooldown_seconds + min_replicas to prevent scaling thrash. also show typical fallback order (same-region reserved -> cross-region reserved -> cheaper hosted variant) and label it "typical ordering" not a guarantee.
mira: noted. will reword SLA lines to be conservative ("targets"/"aims to"), add changelog entry, and push in ~1 hour. ping reviewers after push.
dash: tiny editorial nit: change 'isolation_tags' -> 'isolation_labels' in prose but keep yaml example as 'isolation_tags' to show mapping for infra teams. add a one-liner that SDK param names may differ by release.
mira: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
